kari-revops: Incoming dispute from Luma.ai (L-214). They claim an unexplained embed surge on 2026-06-14 around 07:20Z. Their dashboard shows steady traffic but our ledger jumped. Asking for root cause + refund if warranted.
ryan-sales: CSM already asked for a quick estimate for the customer. Can we get a ballpark and decide if we should issue a provisional credit?
omar-platform: I sampled raw ingest and saw a cluster of retries from a partner proxy that re-sent identical payloads but generated new request_ids. We do capture client_id_hash for ~65% of embeds; those overlap and indicate duplicates.
tess-billing: Can you quantify duplicates and translate to USD? I have authority to approve up to $3k.
omar-platform: Running quick query. SQL: ```-- find duplicate embeds by client_payload_hash within 2m window
SELECT client_payload_hash, count(*) as cnt, sum(embedding_units) as units
FROM embed_raw_events
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2026-06-14T07:15:00Z' AND '2026-06-14T07:30:00Z'
GROUP BY client_payload_hash
HAVING count(*) > 1;```
ingest-bot: quick-scan: duplicate_rows=62, duplicated_units=178900, est_usd=1,789.00 (using current rate). Note: sample run, full ledger join pending.
kari-revops: If that holds, it's under Tess's threshold. Proposal: issue a provisional credit equal to the estimated USD, mark as provisional pending full reconcile. Also kick off a dedupe backfill & a permanent router change to emit dedupe_key = client_payload_hash.	tess-billing: I can approve provisional credits up to $3,000. Approved provisional credit $1,789.00 to Luma.ai (L-214). Please attach CSV export of collisions and job id for audit.
paul-finance: FYI prefer rounding policy: round to nearest dollar and mark memo as "provisional - pending ledger reconcile". If backfill validates, we'll post final GL. If backfill shows less, we'll reverse the difference.
omar-platform: Scheduling job BF-20260614-dedupe (audit-only). Plan: canary run (1% traffic) then full replay. Risk: if some duplicate acks already landed in ledger, backfill must avoid creating duplicates; we'll write dedupe-on-ingest logic for the job. Estimated run+verify 3h.
ryan-sales: I'll notify CSM & customer: "We've issued a provisional credit of $1,789.00 while we run an internal reconciliation job. Expect confirmation within 48 hours." :pray:
ingest-bot: backfill job created: https://jobs.internal/BF-20260614-dedupe status=scheduled runbook=RB-dedupe-005
kari-revops: Also open a ticket on partner integration to ask them to stop re-sending on 5xx without preserving client_payload_hash; we'll request they adopt idempotent retries.
tess-billing: Once the job completes, post final ledger delta and attach CSV and checksum. Then I'll convert provisional credit to final credit or issue adjustment.
paul-finance: Approved on my end too. paul-finance notes: please include GL code REB_EMB_DUP in memo.
kari-revops: Thanks all. I'll follow up with the CSV and job logs when available so accounting can close the dispute"
